title: Fix Drug Interaction checker to compute fresh, validated local results on each manual check

requirements.summary: Replace stubbed interaction-check hooks with real client-side React Query queries so each click computes and renders results for the current manual inputs (Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, Food-Food).
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Drug Interaction module, when the user enters valid values and clicks "Check interactions" in the Drug-Drug tab, the results list updates to match the current input values (not previous inputs).

Given the Drug Interaction module, when the user enters valid values and clicks "Check interactions" in the Drug-Food tab, the results list updates to match the current input values (not previous inputs).

Given the Drug Interaction module, when the user enters valid values and clicks "Check interactions" in the Food-Food tab, the results list updates to match the current input values (not previous inputs).
The interaction hooks provide working loading and error states (isLoading/isPending/error) so the UI can show a spinner/skeleton and an error message when needed.
The query keys include the normalized input set(s) so re-checking after editing inputs always triggers a fresh computation and re-render.

file_operations.description: Replace the stubbed hooks (useCheckMultiDrugInteraction/useCheckDrugFoodInteractions/useCheckFoodFoodInteractions) with real useQuery-based hooks that: (1) compute results client-side, (2) expose isLoading/isPending/error from React Query, and (3) use query keys that include a stable, normalized representation of the current inputs (sorted + normalization) so changing inputs and clicking "Check interactions" always triggers a fresh computation and re-render.

Add a client-side service that performs the three interaction computations (Drug-Drug multi-pair, Drug-Food combinations, Food-Food unique pairs) and returns result shapes matching the existing UI cards. Centralize normalization, sorting, and pair generation so the React Query hooks can call a single computation layer.

Wire the updated hooks into the UI so the module renders loading skeleton/spinner and error messages using the returned isLoading/isPending/error states, and ensure the "Check interactions" buttons update the hook inputs from the latest manual entries (no stale state).

requirements.summary: Implement and enforce manual-input validation for Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, and Food-Food checks and show clear English validation messages without running checks when invalid.
acceptanceCriteria: Drug-Drug: If fewer than 2 medications are entered, show: "Please enter at least two medications to check interactions." and do not run the check.
Drug-Drug: If duplicate drug names are entered (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive), show: "Please enter different medications. Duplicate drug names detected." and do not run the check.
Drug-Food: If no drug is entered or no food is entered, show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.
Drug-Food: If duplicate drugs or duplicate foods are entered (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive), show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.
Food-Food: If fewer than 2 foods are entered, show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.
Food-Food: If duplicate food names are entered (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive), show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.

file_operations.description: Add/complete validation logic for Drug-Food and Food-Food (and keep Drug-Drug behavior) using existing normalization-based duplicate detection. Prevent updating the "toCheck" state and prevent marking "search performed" when validation fails; display the specified English messages in the module for each tab.

Add small shared helpers (input normalization/deduplication utilities used by hooks) to keep query keys and computations consistent with the UI’s validation rules (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive comparisons).

requirements.summary: Ensure Drug Interaction results are computed from local datasets/indexes (drug-drug, drug-food, food-food) and continue working without backend/actor availability.
acceptanceCriteria: Drug-Drug results are produced from the local drug-drug interaction data source and are returned as an array of interaction cards (including "No interaction data found..." cards for missing pairs) that matches the pairings from the entered drugs.
Drug-Food results are produced from the local drug-food interaction dataset/index for each selected drug-food combination, returning a consistent result shape used by the existing UI cards.
Food-Food results are produced from the local food-food interaction dataset/index for each unique food pair entered, returning a consistent result shape used by the existing UI cards.
Performing checks does not require any Motoko/backend changes and works even if the actor is unavailable.

file_operations.description: Implement computations strictly using existing local sources: (1) drug-drug lookups via the existing local drug-drug dataset/index utilities, (2) drug-food lookups via the cached drug-food index utilities, and (3) food-food lookups via the cached food-food index utilities. Ensure results include explicit “no data” objects where needed so the existing cards render the built-in “No interaction data found...” states.

Ensure the new interaction-check React Query hooks do not depend on useActor/actor availability and never call backend canister methods for these checks; all queryFns should use only the local interaction check service, so checks work even when the actor is unavailable.
